visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontally scrolling row of cruise product cards with previous/next arrows and an "n of N" counter drawn by the block

contentPattern.structure: One row per card: 1) image; 2) details: heading with the itinerary link, region, departure date, nights; 3) offer badge text (optional, may be empty); 4) price line and small print. The arrows and counter are generated, not authored

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of bookable cruises. The "n of N" arrows under the cards are part of this block; do not import them as page text.
